description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class named AccountController, which provides CRUD endpoints for managing bank accounts in a Spring Boot application. It includes methods for retrieving all accounts, fetching an account by ID, creating a new account, updating an account's balance, and deleting an account.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: A REST controller exposing CRUD endpoints for bank account management, leveraging Spring's annotations for HTTP mappings and dependency injection.

methods.name: getAllAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of all accounts by calling the account repository's findAll() method.

methods.name: getAccountById
methods.description: Retrieves an account by its ID; throws ResourceNotFoundException if the account does not exist.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account based on the validated Account object received in the request body.

methods.name: updateAmount
methods.description: Updates the balance of an existing account by adding a delta amount provided either via query parameter or request body; returns the updated account.

methods.name: deleteAccount
methods.description: Deletes an account by its ID and returns an HTTP 200 OK response.
